title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #16

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is an example of a good thought? (1 mark)
   A. I hope she falls
   B. I will not greet anyone
   C. I will help my mother with the dishes
   D. I will take my friend's book

2. Which of these is part of the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. A bus driver
   B. A shopkeeper
   C. An uncle
   D. A classmate

3. A child lives with a grandmother and an aunt because her parents work far away. Is this a family? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   B. No, it is only a group of neighbours
   C. Only if they are rich
   D. No, only parents and children make a family

4. What is an attribute of God? (1 mark)
   A. A quality that describes what God is like
   B. A kind of building
   C. A song
   D. A holiday

5. In the reference John 3:16, what does the number 16 stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The verse
   B. The chapter
   C. The book
   D. The page

6. Which is a poetry and wisdom book in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus
   B. Isaiah
   C. Psalms
   D. Joshua

7. Which book comes directly after Genesis? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus
   B. Numbers
   C. Leviticus
   D. Joshua

8. How many times did the donkey turn aside or stop before she spoke? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. One
   C. Five
   D. Three

9. What did the donkey say to Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   B. I am tired
   C. Give me water
   D. Please go home

10. What should a child do if they meet a dangerous animal? (1 mark)
   A. Stay away and call adults
   B. Try to fight it
   C. Throw stones
   D. Go closer

11. What did Joseph advise Pharaoh to store during the good years? (1 mark)
   A. Half the animals
   B. All the harvest
   C. Nothing
   D. One fifth of the harvest

12. What was Zechariah's job? (1 mark)
   A. Tax collector
   B. Priest
   C. Fisherman
   D. Soldier

13. Where did John preach? (1 mark)
   A. Near the River Jordan
   B. In Rome
   C. In Egypt
   D. In Antioch

14. What was Bartimaeus' problem? (1 mark)
   A. He was a leper
   B. He was lame
   C. He was deaf
   D. He was blind

15. Which is a kind way to help a blind person? (1 mark)
   A. Move their things
   B. Laugh at them
   C. Leave them out
   D. Greet them by name and offer to guide them

16. What did Jesus say made Bartimaeus well? (1 mark)
   A. His shouting
   B. His cloak
   C. His money
   D. His faith

17. How many men with leprosy met Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Twelve
   C. Two
   D. Five

18. How many came back to thank Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. One
   B. Ten
   C. Nine
   D. None

19. What does gratitude mean? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Being angry
   C. Boasting
   D. Showing thanks

20. Which of these is an act of compassion? (1 mark)
   A. Teasing a sad friend
   B. Laughing at a friend's loss
   C. Comforting a grieving friend
   D. Ignoring a lonely child

21. What is revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing
   B. Praying
   C. Forgiving
   D. Hurting someone because they hurt you

22. A classmate breaks your pencil by accident. What is the best response? (1 mark)
   A. Break his pencil
   B. Forgive and accept the apology
   C. Tell others lies
   D. Shout at him

23. What does sharing at school help to build? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness and unity
   B. Laziness
   C. Selfishness
   D. Jealousy

24. In the parable, who does the woman stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A sinner
   B. God
   C. A shopkeeper
   D. A priest

25. What does the seed grow into? (1 mark)
   A. A small flower
   B. A large tree
   C. A river
   D. A rock

26. What does "evangelise" mean? (1 mark)
   A. To cook
   B. To build
   C. To plant seeds
   D. To tell others the good news about Jesus

27. Which of these is a trusted person at school? (1 mark)
   A. Someone who asks for secrets
   B. A person who offers gifts
   C. Your class teacher
   D. A stranger at the gate

28. What does it mean to trust someone? (1 mark)
   A. To hide from them
   B. To argue with them
   C. To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   D. To fear them

29. Is love only a feeling? (1 mark)
   A. No, it is also a choice and action
   B. Only for adults
   C. Only in church
   D. Yes

30. Which command did Jesus give in John 13:34? (1 mark)
   A. Fast
   B. Give money
   C. Go to the temple
   D. Love one another

31. Who is your neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Only relatives
   B. Anyone near you or in need
   C. Only people next door
   D. Only friends

32. What should you do with a borrowed book? (1 mark)
   A. Sell it
   B. Keep it
   C. Damage it
   D. Return it in good condition

33. Which action honours God with the body? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping clean and eating well
   B. Using bad words
   C. Taking drugs
   D. Fighting

34. Which is an activity in church? (1 mark)
   A. Selling goods
   B. Praying and singing
   C. Playing football inside
   D. Fighting

35. Which behaviour shows respect for the church? (1 mark)
   A. Running
   B. Entering quietly
   C. Shouting
   D. Littering

36. Who was Andrew's brother? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. Simon Peter
   C. Philip
   D. John

37. Which verse warns about bad company? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. 1 Corinthians 15:33
   C. John 3:16
   D. Genesis 1:1

38. How many fruits of the Spirit are listed? (1 mark)
   A. Twelve
   B. Five
   C. Seven
   D. Nine

39. What should you do if someone offers you a harmful drug? (1 mark)
   A. Sell it
   B. Hide it
   C. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   D. Try it

40. What is social media? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. A school
   C. Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   D. A newspaper

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Where were believers first called Christians? (2 marks)

42. Write John 3:16 in your own words and explain what it teaches. (4 marks)

43. State three lessons that we learn from the story of Joseph interpreting the dream. (3 marks)

44. Explain how to find Luke 19:1-10 in the Bible. (4 marks)

45. State three results of telling lies. (3 marks)

46. Describe how the story of the shepherd boy and the wolf shows the results of lying. (4 marks)

47. Who was Nicodemus? (2 marks)

48. State three reasons why we should pray every day. (3 marks)

49. Explain Ephesians 4:26 and show how a child can apply it when a friend has hurt them. (5 marks)

50. Describe how Daniel made a right choice in Babylon and give two lessons a child can learn from him. (5 marks)

51. Name two of the twelve disciples who were brothers. (2 marks)

52. List two attributes of God. (2 marks)

53. Give two examples of school property. (2 marks)

54. Give two people you should pray for. (2 marks)

55. Explain what the story teaches about gratitude and give one example from school life. (4 marks)

56. Explain what "forgive" means. (2 marks)

57. Explain four ways of showing responsibility at school. (4 marks)

58. Explain how a child can show faith in God when they or a family member is sick. (5 marks)

59. Name two members of the extended family. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — I will help my mother with the dishes
   Helping at home is a thought that leads to kindness.

2. C — An uncle
   Uncles are relatives outside the nuclear family.

3. A — Yes, every family that cares for a child should be respected
   Families come in different forms, and each deserves love and respect.

4. A — A quality that describes what God is like
   An attribute is a quality that describes someone.

5. A — The verse
   In John 3:16, John is the book, 3 is the chapter, and 16 is the verse.

6. C — Psalms
   Psalms, Proverbs and Job are among the poetry and wisdom books.

7. A — Exodus
   The order is Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.

8. D — Three
   Balaam struck her three times.

9. A — What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   Numbers 22:28 records the donkey's question.

10. A — Stay away and call adults
   The story is not a call to fight animals.

11. D — One fifth of the harvest
   Genesis 41:34 says to take a fifth.

12. B — Priest
   Luke 1:5 says he was a priest.

13. A — Near the River Jordan
   John preached in the wilderness by the Jordan.

14. D — He was blind
   Bartimaeus was a blind beggar.

15. D — Greet them by name and offer to guide them
   Kindness and respect help people with disabilities.

16. D — His faith
   Jesus said, "Your faith has healed you."

17. A — Ten
   Luke 17:12 says ten men met Him.

18. A — One
   Only one returned.

19. D — Showing thanks
   Gratitude is being thankful.

20. C — Comforting a grieving friend
   Comfort shows care.

21. D — Hurting someone because they hurt you
   Revenge is paying back harm.

22. B — Forgive and accept the apology
   Forgiveness restores friendship.

23. A — Kindness and unity
   Sharing builds love and friendship.

24. B — God
   The searching woman stands for God's love.

25. B — A large tree
   The seed grew and became a tree.

26. D — To tell others the good news about Jesus
   Evangelising means sharing the gospel.

27. C — Your class teacher
   Teachers help keep children safe.

28. C — To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   Trust means believing someone is reliable.

29. A — No, it is also a choice and action
   Love is shown in actions.

30. D — Love one another
   Jesus said to love as He loved.

31. B — Anyone near you or in need
   A neighbour is anyone we can help.

32. D — Return it in good condition
   Borrowed items must be returned.

33. A — Keeping clean and eating well
   Care for the body honours God.

34. B — Praying and singing
   Worship includes prayer and singing.

35. B — Entering quietly
   Quiet respect honours God's house.

36. B — Simon Peter
   Simon Peter and Andrew were brothers.

37. B — 1 Corinthians 15:33
   Bad company corrupts good character.

38. D — Nine
   There are nine.

39. C — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

40. C — Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   Social media lets people connect.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Antioch (Acts 11:26).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Antioch and 1 for reference or the meaning.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son so that everyone who believes in Him will not be lost but will have eternal life. It teaches God's love and the way to eternal life.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's love, 1 for giving Jesus, 1 for believing, 1 for eternal life.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Depend on God; do not give up when life is unfair; use gifts to serve others; save for hard times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use the contents page to find the book of Luke. Turn to chapter 19. Then find verses 1 to 10 within that chapter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for finding the book, 1 for the chapter, 1 for the verses, 1 for using the contents page.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of trust, punishment, guilt, broken friendships.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy lied twice that a wolf was coming. Villagers came and found nothing. When a real wolf came, nobody believed him. Lies destroy trust.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who visited Jesus at night.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Pharisee or leader and 1 for visiting Jesus.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: We can thank God; ask for help; grow spiritually; know God better; get strength to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ephesians 4:26 says to be angry without sinning and not to keep the anger overnight. A child should calm down, avoid hitting or insulting, talk to the friend kindly or ask an adult to help, forgive, and pray for peace before the day ends.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the verse, 1 for not sinning in anger, 1 for calming down, 1 for talking or forgiving, 1 for prayer or making peace quickly.

50. (5 marks)
   Answer: Daniel decided not to defile himself with the king's food and politely asked for permission to eat differently. Lessons: it is good to stay faithful to God even when far from home or when no one is watching; we can stand for what is right politely and respectfully; God blesses those who stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for describing the decision, 1 for politeness or asking permission, 2 for two lessons, 1 for clear expression.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Peter and Andrew; James and John.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sole Creator, loving Father, holy. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each attribute.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Desks, textbooks, library books, toilets, compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parents, guardians, friends, teachers, sick people, leaders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: Jesus noticed that only one of the ten returned to thank Him. We should be thankful to God and to people. Example: thanking a teacher who helped with a difficult lesson.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the lesson, 1 for Jesus noticing, 1 for a school example, 1 for explanation of gratitude.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: To stop being angry with someone and not pay them back for the wrong they did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping anger and 1 for not paying back.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep the class clean, take care of books, obey rules, do assigned duties, return borrowed things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

58. (5 marks)
   Answer: Pray, believe that God cares, ask trusted adults, go to a clinic or hospital for treatment, thank God for help, and continue to trust. Faith does not mean ignoring doctors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer, 1 for belief in God's care, 1 for seeking treatment, 1 for thanks, 1 for continuing to trust.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Grandfather, grandmother, uncle, aunt, cousin. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct member.
